text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri, where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Dang it. I couldn't find her anywhere,
not in the onsen, not in the restaurant,
and not in the lobby.
Do you think she left? 
Ugh, this was supposed to be a group
vacation!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I hope she's okay… There's so much
delicious 
food in Osaka,
so the smell may have lured her in.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That sounds stupid. No… since it's Oguri,
I guess 
anything is possible. Ah,
whatever! I'll go look for her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This is delicious… It's so sweet and 
tender… Osaka's fried carrot is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
where am I?
I only planned to snack a little 
bit then head back,
but I don't remember the way back…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! If you come out now,
I'll treat you to something yummy!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I know you're a good girl,
so please come back. 
Hey, Tama-chan,
have you tried calling her phone?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I did, but I think her phone's dead… 
And I told her to charge it before going to
bed too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *munch* *munch* It's been a long time since I got lost… What should I do? I wonder if the others are worried about me…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nngh, I feel so anxious…and when I get anxious,
I get hungry… 
Umm, excuse me…can I have five servings of
takoyaki please.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's so lively here!
I can really feel the Osaka-energy♪ 
Hmm? There's a huge crowd over here,
I wonder what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Attendant A
text_block_list.text:
Holy…! How many kilos can you eat?! 
Uma Musume sure can eat a lot, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *munch* *munch* *munch* *munch* *sniffle*

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san?! Wait,
are you crying?! What's the matter?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I can't believe this!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're just lucky that Laurel happened to
pass by!
But miracles don't happen often,
you know?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry… I just really wanted to
try 
the breakfast from your hometown…then I got
lost…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But…every bit of it was so delicious… 
And being able to experience what you 
grew up with made me so happy… I'm so
sorry…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's with you?! Ah jeez, whatever!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
As long as you reflect on what you did,
it's fine. 
Let's start our Summer Walk over again.
I know a place with the best pork buns,
so let's go get some together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The best? Thank you so much, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, as a thank you, Laurel,
you can have these 
lottery tickets that I got from the nearby
shopping district. I got a bunch today,
so here you go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (So, using the tickets Oguri gave me, I decided to try my luck at the lottery…)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (…but I never expected to win the top prize, a trip to Hokkaido♪ Hehe, this year's Summer Walk sure is great, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (I've already seen the racecourse and had some delicious ice cream and melon. Now all that's left is…Brian's rehabilitation.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe… I wonder if the fan event is going
well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We're about to begin the Lunchtime Stroll
Event. 
It's essentially a facility tour.
Whoever wants to come, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey now!
If you keep talking like that you'll scare
away your fans,
especially the little ones!
I'm sorry for her attitude.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
she's not a bad Uma Musume.
She's been thinking 
about this event for a long time,
and even asked Hishi Ama for he—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oi! …Ama-san, why is she even here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She said she was bored so I decided to invite
her. 
Anyway,
let's focus on the fan event!
Let's go before the sun sets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, seems like they've got enough help already.
That's a relief. 
In that case,
I might secretly enjoy the fan event a bit
myself♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I love this park!
It's great for picnics and
it's so spacious!
It also smells super nice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't get overexcited,
or else you might trip…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've also got a ranch attached to the
facility! 
You can try milking cows if you'd like,
the ice 
cream from their milk is so delicious! Right,
Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
yeah… You sure know a lot about this place,
Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look, a fish! There's so many of them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You can do river rafting and some fishing
here. 
But remember that you need a reservation in
order to do so!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't you know a little too much…?

text_block_list.name: Brian's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-chan, you studied up a bunch to 
help out Brian-san, didn't you? How kind… 
Just listening to the way you explain things
is so soothing…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (And that's how Brian-chan's Lunchtime Stroll Event concluded smoothly and harmoniously without any trouble…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
How much longer do you plan on lurking
around?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
I didn't expect you to catch me since I was
being 
so discreet.
The fan event was so much fun by the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch… I only did it because I was asked by
a caretaker I'm 
indebted to. Otherwise,
I wouldn't bother doing all of this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh by the way, Laurel, didn't you mention 
you were having issues with your legs?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
don't worry about that!
I'm feeling much better today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You two should eat more! 
Eating is how you get stronger after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's right!
Food is the source of energy! Alright,
I'm gonna prepare a feast for us tonight,
so 
make sure to eat to your heart's content
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (For us, summer is important for recharging. I hope we'll have enough energy for what's coming in autumn…)
